title: 57-day Dry Cargo Time Charter
agency_path: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE NAVY.MSC.MSC HQS.MSCHQ NORFOLK
detail_text: Action Code: Pre-solicitation Date: 09 April 2026 Year: Fiscal Year 2026 Contracting Office Zip Code: 23511 Product or Service Code: V124 - Transportation/Travel/Relocation - Transportation: Marine Charter Contracting Office Address: 471 East C Street, Naval Station Norfolk, Norfolk, VA 23511 Subject: 57-day Dry Cargo Time Charter Proposed Solicitation Number: N3220526R6076 Closing Response Date: Thursday, 16 April 2026 Contract Point of Contact or Contract Specialist: Brandon Page at brandon.a.page.civ@us.navy.mil or 564-226-1239 and Michelle James at michelle.d.james7.civ@us.navy.mil or (564) 230-3323 Contract Award and Solicitation Number: TBD Contract Award Dollar Amount: TBD Contract Line Item Number: N/A Contract Award Date: TBA Contractor: TBD Description: This requirement is for One, U.S. or foreign flag, self-sustaining vessel capable of carrying a minimum of 500 TEUs of containerized ammunition while satisfying all applicable regulatory HAZMAT compatibility and segregation requirements. Place of Contract Performance: The place/range of delivery and place/range of redelivery is Military Ocean Terminal Concord, California, (USA). The layday commences and cancels 27 May 2026, and the charter period is about 57 days for each charter. Set-aside Status: Total Small Business Set-Aside. The decision to release this procurement as “Total Small Business Set-Aside” is based on responses received from a recent, sources sought notice for this service. The Deputy Director of MSC’s Office of Small Business Programs has concurred with this decision.
